title: fix(site): move next 16.3.3 to 16.3.6 for GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j (critical)
body:
Fixes #11356

## Summary

`next` 16.3.3 carries GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j (critical, CVSS 9.5, "Remote Code Execution in next/og ImageResponse"). The fixed release is 16.3.6. On `main` at `2124d04111`, `apps/site/package.json` pins `"next": "16.3.3"` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` resolves `next@16.3.3`. The surface is reachable: `apps/site/app/og/docs/[...slug]/route.tsx` imports `ImageResponse` from `'next/og'`, and the production build prerenders 184 PNGs through it.

This PR moves to the patched release. It supersedes Dependabot's #11235 (manifest only, so every install step failed with `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE`) and #11236 (a full re-resolution that gave nanoid and vite each an extra physical copy). It adds no OSV or audit exemption, and the lockfile is not hand-edited.

## Change

- `apps/site/package.json`: the `next` line only, `16.3.3` to `16.3.6`, still an exact pin. No other objectui manifest declares `next`: `git grep '"next"'` over every `package.json` at `2124d04111` has exactly one hit, this line.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: regenerated with `pnpm install --lockfile-only` under pnpm 10.31.0 (the `packageManager` version), starting from `main`'s lockfile unchanged.

## Lockfile

55 lines changed on each side.

- `packages:` has 1767 entries before and after. 10 are removed and 10 added: `next`, `@next/env` and the eight `@next/swc-*` binaries, each 16.3.3 to 16.3.6.
- `snapshots:` has 1773 entries before and after. 14 are removed and 14 added: the same 10, plus the four snapshot keys that embed the `next` version as a peer. Those are `fumadocs-core`, `fumadocs-mdx`, `fumadocs-ui`, and `better-auth`, whose optional `next` peer resolves to the workspace copy. None of the four changes version.
- Two importers change: `apps/site`, and `packages/auth` through the `better-auth` snapshot key only (its specifier and version are unchanged).
- The string `16.3.3` no longer appears anywhere in the lockfile.

## Verification

Every row below was measured on `76e9ee3`, this branch's head. `main` was still at `2124d04111` when this PR was opened, so there was nothing to merge.

The runs used Node 22.23.3. This container ships Node 22.22.0, and the repository's `engine-strict=true` refuses it, because `jsdom@30.0.1` requires `^22.22.2`. CI is unaffected: its `setup-node` asks for `22.x`, which takes the newest 22 release. See Acceptance notes.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/check-lockfile-integrity.mjs --base-ref origin/main` (the gate #11236 failed) | exit 0, `VERDICT clean`: 1773 resolutions on both sides, no backward move, no new copy. `--self-test` exit 0, 29 cases |
| `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` | exit 0, and the installed `apps/site/node_modules/next` reads 16.3.6 |
| Control leg: `main`'s lockfile with this branch's manifest, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` | exit 1, `ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE` (the #11235 failure). Restored afterwards: `git diff HEAD` empty, blob hash equal to HEAD's |
| `node scripts/check-lockfile-dedupe.mjs` (bare, the hard verdict) | exit 0, `VERDICT deduped` |
| `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/site'` (the `Build Docs` command), under the shared verify lock, `--concurrency=2` | exit 0, 30/30 tasks, `Next.js 16.3.6 (Turbopack)`. The site task was a cache miss, so it really ran: 559 static pages, including 184 `/og/docs/**/image.png` prerendered through `ImageResponse`, each a real PNG |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/site type-check` (`fumadocs-mdx && next typegen && tsc --noEmit`) | exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth type-check`, then `pnpm exec vitest run packages/auth/` (the importer whose snapshot key moved) | exit 0. 28 files, 282 tests passed |
| The 10 test files that read `pnpm-lock.yaml` or resolve through `apps/site`: `ci-cd-pipeline-doc`, `docs-build-trigger`, `check-installed-spec-pin-claims`, `check-lockfile-integrity`, `check-lockfile-dedupe`, `check-pre-install-import-graph`, `markdown-test-inputs`, `check-doc-links`, `check-changeset-presence`, `MetadataService.specKeyReference` | 10 files, 479 tests passed |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0, "no changeset is owed" |
| `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:pre-install-import-graph`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `type-check:coverage` | all exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test apps/site/package.json pnpm-lock.yaml` | `NOT GOVERNED` |

Left to CI: the repository-wide `pnpm lint` and `pnpm type-check`, the eight test shards, coverage, `Build & E2E`, and `Bundle Analysis`. No package source changes.

## OSV-Scanner, before and after

I ran OSV-Scanner v2.3.8 as `scan --offline-vulnerabilities --lockfile=pnpm-lock.yaml`, against its offline npm database. The binary's SHA-256 (`bc98e153…`) matches the release's checksum file. objectui has no OSV workflow, so this is a reading, not a gate.

| Tree | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `main` at `2124d04111` | 1 | 62 rows, 1 Critical: `GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j`, `next` 16.3.3 |
| this branch at `76e9ee3` | 1 | 61 rows, 0 Critical |

The two row sets differ by exactly one line: the `next` advisory is gone, and no row is added. The other 61 rows are already on `main` and are outside this card.

## Changeset

None. `apps/site` is `"private": true`, and no published package's source or contract changes. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` settles it (exit 0, above).

## Acceptance notes

- **Overlap with draft #11335** (another seat). It also touches `pnpm-lock.yaml`, but only in the `importers:` block of a different package (it adds an `@object-ui/sdui-parser` workspace link). Its hunks are disjoint from this PR's. If git reports a conflict for whichever lands second, regenerate with `pnpm install --lockfile-only`; do not hand-merge.
- **Alert count.** The push banner reported 2 critical Dependabot alerts on the default branch. OSV over `pnpm-lock.yaml` reads 1 Critical, the one fixed here. Where the second one comes from was not measured.
- **Node floor.** Root `engines.node` declares `>=22.11`, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` repeats it. But `jsdom@30.0.1` declares `^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0`, and `.npmrc` sets `engine-strict=true`. So on Node 22.22.0, which the declared floor admits, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` stops with `ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE` naming jsdom. This PR does not change that. It is reported to the dispatching seat for a separate card. Locally I used a checksum-verified Node 22.23.3 from a scratch directory rather than turning `engine-strict` off.
